assessments.title: Configure an AI Agent for Customer Support
assessments.scenario: You are tasked with setting up an AI agent for a retail company to handle customer inquiries about order status, returns, and product information.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and create a new agent.
2. Configure the agent settings to include generative AI orchestration and manage skills relevant to customer support.
3. Define actions for checking order status, processing returns, and providing product information.
4. Set up triggers for common customer inquiries to initiate the appropriate actions.
5. Document the configuration process and any challenges faced.
expected_outputs: Configured AI agent with appropriate settings and skills
Defined actions for order status, returns, and product information
Triggers set up for common inquiries

assessments.title: Design a Conversational Flow for a Banking Chatbot
assessments.scenario: A bank wants to implement a chatbot to assist customers with account balance inquiries, transaction history, and branch locations.
assessments.instructions:
1. Use the Topics tab to define intents for account balance inquiries, transaction history, and branch locations.
2. Create conversation flows that guide users through these inquiries, ensuring clarity and ease of use.
3. Test the conversation flows using the Test your agent panel to ensure accuracy and relevance of responses.
4. Analyze user engagement data from the Activity tab to identify areas for improvement.
5. Provide a report on the design process and any improvements made based on testing and analysis.
expected_outputs: Defined intents and conversation flows for banking inquiries

assessments.title: Integrate an AI Agent with a CRM System
assessments.scenario: A company wants to integrate their AI agent with a CRM system to automate customer data updates and notifications.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and navigate to the Connectors/Integrations section.
2. Set up the integration with the CRM system to allow the agent to update customer data and send notifications.
3. Utilize APIs to enhance the agent's functionality and ensure seamless data exchange.
4. Deploy the agent across multiple channels using the Channels tab.
5. Document the integration process and any issues encountered.
expected_outputs: Integrated AI agent with CRM system

assessments.title: Implement Security and Governance for an AI Agent
assessments.scenario: A healthcare organization needs to ensure their AI agent complies with security protocols and governance standards.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and configure the agent's authentication settings to meet healthcare security standards.
2. Ensure the agent adheres to governance and responsible AI principles as outlined in the Responsible AI FAQs.
3. Use the Analytics tab to monitor the agent's performance and compliance with security and governance standards.
4. Provide a report detailing the security configurations, governance adherence, and performance analytics.
expected_outputs: Configured security settings for healthcare standards

item_bank.stem: Design a conversation flow for an AI agent that handles customer inquiries about product returns. Include intents, triggers, and responses.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should include a detailed conversation flow with defined intents such as 'Product Return Inquiry', triggers like 'return policy', and responses that guide the user through the return process.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the clarity and completeness of the conversation flow, ensuring all necessary intents, triggers, and responses are included.

item_bank.stem: Analyze the user engagement data from the Analytics tab to identify areas where the AI agent's conversation design can be improved.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The analysis should identify patterns in user interactions, such as frequent drop-off points or misunderstood intents, and suggest improvements to the conversation design.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Look for a thorough analysis of the data and actionable recommendations for improving user engagement.

item_bank.stem: Configure an AI agent to authenticate users before providing access to sensitive information. Describe the steps and settings involved.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should detail the configuration process, including setting up authentication protocols and managing security settings within the agent's platform.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Ensure the response includes all necessary steps and settings for secure user authentication.

item_bank.stem: Evaluate the effectiveness of a newly integrated API in enhancing the AI agent's functionality. What metrics would you use and why?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The evaluation should include metrics such as response time, error rate, and user satisfaction, explaining how each metric relates to the API's effectiveness.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Assess the appropriateness of the chosen metrics and the rationale provided for their selection.

item_bank.stem: Create a test case to measure the accuracy of an AI agent's responses to frequently asked questions. Include expected outcomes and evaluation criteria.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The test case should include sample questions, expected responses, and criteria for evaluating accuracy, such as response relevance and correctness.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Check for comprehensive test cases with clear expected outcomes and evaluation criteria.

item_bank.stem: Describe how you would deploy an AI agent across multiple communication channels using the Channels tab. What considerations must be taken into account?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The description should cover the steps for deploying the agent on various channels and considerations such as channel-specific features and user demographics.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the completeness of the deployment process and the relevance of the considerations mentioned.

item_bank.stem: Outline a governance framework to ensure an AI agent adheres to responsible AI principles. What key elements should be included?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The framework should include elements such as ethical guidelines, compliance checks, and regular audits to ensure adherence to responsible AI principles.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Look for a well-structured framework with clear and relevant elements that promote responsible AI practices.

item_bank.stem: Configure an AI agent to send an email notification when a specific event is triggered. Detail the configuration process.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The configuration process should include defining the trigger event, setting up the email action, and ensuring the correct parameters are used for the email content.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Ensure the response includes all necessary steps and details for successful email notification setup.

item_bank.stem: Analyze the performance analytics of an AI agent to determine its compliance with set performance standards. What insights can be drawn?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The analysis should identify key performance metrics, compare them against standards, and provide insights into areas of compliance or needed improvement.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Assess the depth of analysis and the relevance of insights drawn from the performance data.

item_bank.stem: Design a workflow for an AI agent that integrates with an external CRM system to update customer records. Include triggers and actions.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The workflow should include a trigger such as 'customer inquiry', actions like 'update CRM record', and a clear sequence of steps for integration.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the logical flow and completeness of the workflow, ensuring all necessary triggers and actions are included.

blueprint.target_audience: AI developers, system integrators, and IT professionals working in enterprise environments
blueprint.prerequisites: Candidates should have a foundational understanding of AI concepts, basic programming skills, and familiarity with enterprise IT systems.
blueprint.program_overview:
The AI Champion Certification is designed to validate the expertise of professionals in the creation, configuration, and management of AI agents within enterprise environments. This certification ensures that candidates possess the necessary skills to design conversational interfaces, integrate AI solutions with external systems, and adhere to stringent security and governance standards. The program is structured to provide a comprehensive understanding of AI agent lifecycle management, from initial configuration to deployment and ongoing optimization.

Candidates will gain proficiency in key areas such as agent creation and configuration, conversational design, and system integration. The certification also emphasizes the importance of security and governance, ensuring that AI solutions are not only effective but also compliant with industry standards. Through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application, participants will be equipped to implement AI solutions that enhance business operations and improve user engagement.
domain_summary: Agent Creation & Configuration: Master the skills required to create and configure AI agents, including defining actions, triggers, and workflows.
Conversational Design: Learn to design effective conversation flows and manage topics for accurate and relevant agent responses.
Connectors/Integrations: Gain expertise in integrating AI agents with external systems and deploying them across various channels.
Security & Governance: Ensure AI agents adhere to security protocols and governance standards, including responsible AI practices.
blueprint.assessment_strategy: The AI Champion Certification employs a performance-based assessment strategy, focusing on real-world application and problem-solving skills. Candidates are evaluated through a series of practical assessments that simulate enterprise scenarios, requiring them to demonstrate their ability to configure AI agents, design conversation flows, and integrate systems. This approach ensures that certified professionals are not only knowledgeable but also capable of applying their skills in practical settings. The assessments are designed to test proficiency across all domains, with rubrics providing clear criteria for performance evaluation.
blueprint.renewal_cadence: Recertification is recommended every two years to ensure that professionals remain current with evolving AI technologies and industry standards. This interval allows for the incorporation of new skills and knowledge as the field of AI continues to advance.
